title: Cat turns to fan after intense heat slows down its momentum
description:
You know the heat is no joke when a playful cat abandons all its plans just to cool down.

Shared by Laura, this comical clip shows her walking into her room and finding her pet cat lounging on the bed right in front of the fan.

"Got a bit too hot for this one, haha," Laura told WooGlobe.

It’s safe to assume that July isn’t this feline’s favorite month anymore. For now, it seems the fan is its best ally, and all other plans are on hold until the cooler winds of winter arrive.
